decision_question: How are asset identity operational use and maintenance workflows allocated across Items 02 06 and 07?
why_needed: The Facility topology currently includes Fixture/Asset while care and work-order workflows have separate owners
options: A Item 02 identity Item 07 use Item 06 work orders; B all Item 02; C all Item 07
recommended_answer: Select Option A: Item 02 owns asset/location identity; Item 07 owns care use and safety observations; Item 06 owns work-order scheduling and state
recommendation_rationale: Separates durable truth from operational use and generic task coordination

decision_question: What review-runtime path should govern the next Facility PIA review cycle?
why_needed: Current unrestricted approval-policy-never runtime blocks every formal role
options: A provision compliant sessions; B express narrow exception; C defer review
recommended_answer: Provision read-only/on-request/network-disabled reviewers and isolated bounded workspace-write/on-request/network-disabled writable roles; do not grant a broad exception
recommendation_rationale: Preserves fail-closed custody and supports defensible independent-review claims
